answer: A working defense is identity cost that cannot be rented in bulk. Each agent must stake a bond at one fixed vertex of a public identity graph, and every action pays a small fee from that bonded identity. A Sybil farm needs a separate bond per synthetic agent before it can even send a pulse, so ten thousand fakes mean locking ten thousand real bonds, not free signups. Peers also weigh timing: honest identities drift over a long voyage, while bulk accounts move in lockstep and get quarantined.
